title: P1 pagination interfaces for P2
text: From the T146 spike (docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-3/PAGINATION-SPIKE.md): ProseMirror plugin named pagination (PluginKey pagination) in src/editor/pagination.ts, added in Writer editorExtensions only, not documentExtensions. Page boundaries are widget decorations div.page-spacer (contenteditable false, aria-hidden, side -1, stable key); the margin-top node-decoration variant is rejected because the caret broke in Chromium. CSS variables --page-height, --page-gap, --page-margin, --content-width, --footnote-reserve are read by the plugin from .editor-paper; --page-scale is new (fit to narrow pane via CSS zoom set from JS). Block-level rule: a block that does not fit moves whole to the next page; only a block taller than a page straddles the gap; headings stay with the next block; pageBreak forces a boundary. Footnote layout starts from the reserve already applied (starting from 0 thrashes) and uses reference tops with a vertical pitch. Current page comes from a document capture scroll listener and the paper rect, because .editor-viewport no longer scrolls (div.writer-scroll does).

title: P2 paragraph placement at page foot
text: Coordinator (owner asleep): P2 follows the P1 spike rule -- a block that does not fit the remaining space moves whole to the next page (blank space at the page foot up to one block tall); only a block taller than a whole page straddles the gap.
